meta_title: Topmind — Local-First Knowledge Workbench for the Agent Era
meta_description: Topmind is a local-first personal stream and knowledge workbench. Capture freely → AI organizes → You confirm → Files stay local. Supports Desktop, Obsidian, Agent Skills, CLI/MCP, and browser clipping.
og_description: Capture freely → AI organizes → You confirm → Files stay local. A personal stream and knowledge workbench for the Agent era.
hero_subtitle: A local-first personal stream and knowledge workbench for the Agent era. Capture ideas, web clips, and documents in one place. AI proactively suggests edits, todos, and memory updates — you confirm before anything is written. Your files stay on your disk, always.
philosophy_lead: Traditional note apps demand too much maintenance — manual tagging, linking, and folder decisions drain creative energy. Topmind is a low-friction, flexible, all-in-one personal knowledge and work management tool.
pillar_1_desc: Quick notes, web clips, document extraction, and drafting — all in one place. No more hesitation about "where to put it."
pillar_2_desc: A dynamic timeline by default. Write things down without making complex folder or taxonomy decisions upfront.
pillar_3_title: AI That Is Proactive, Not Intrusive
pillar_3_desc: When AI is enabled, it senses your workspace context and offers just the right knowledge and todo suggestions. AI does the heavy lifting — you keep the final say.
pillar_4_desc: Pure standard Markdown folder storage. Files are the source of truth, always on your local disk, with no proprietary database lock-in.
surfaces_lead: Topmind consists of four core surfaces plus a Clip companion extension. They share content conventions and behavioral contracts, each with independent versioning. Pick the entry that fits your workflow.
surface_desktop_desc: A standalone desktop app with a dynamic main surface, visual AI confirmation UI, and a full editing workflow. Press ⌘N to capture anywhere, anytime.
surface_obsidian_desc: Use the dynamic stream directly inside your existing Obsidian Vault. Supports Community Store, BRAT, and manual installation.
surface_skills_desc: Import Topmind skills into Claude Code / OpenCode / Codex and other AI Agents to drive local knowledge workflows.
surface_utr_desc: Deterministic toolset for Terminal and MCP Server environments. 8 domains, 28 commands, bundled with Desktop.
surface_utr_cmd: npm run utr:list  # view 8 domains / 28 commands
surface_clip_desc: Chrome / Edge browser extension for one-click web capture and content processing. A Desktop companion surface.
workflow_lead: A complete personal knowledge loop, from zero-friction capture to safe archival. Each step has a clear default landing location.
wf_1_desc: Quick-note hotkey · web clip · Office/PDF queue — zero-friction, lightning-fast capture.
wf_2_desc: Edit · inline AI · sidebar Agent · organize topics — dynamic card stream and topic synthesis.
wf_3_desc: Write finished work · confirm before writing to profile/topics — produce deliverables, update personal memory.
wf_4_desc: Search · restore · periodic maintenance — safe archival and fast retrieval.
dir_model_desc: The workspace is organized into three clear planes — self-consistent and predictable.
dir_model_code: # Workspace root {workspace}/ ├── topmind.yaml # System plane: behavioral contract & facade config ├── 00-inbox/ # Content plane: temporary buffer ├── 10-dynamic/ # Content plane: periodic journal ({YYYY}/journal.md) ├── 20-topics/2026-topic/ # Content plane: emergent topic folders │ └── topic.md # Topic homepage ├── 88-output/ # Content plane: flat deliverable files ├── 99-archive/ # Content plane safety: backups · trash · receipts ├── memory/ # Semantic plane: profile · periodic reflections └── .topmind/ # System plane: indexes & logs (safe to delete & rebuild)
install_lead: Four installation scenarios — one will fit your workflow.
install_a_desc: Recommended. One-click install with automatic quarantine cleanup.
install_b_desc: Add the GitHub repo in the BRAT plugin for a quick install.
install_c_desc: Import Topmind skills for Claude Code / OpenCode / Codex.
cap_lead: Every capability is labeled with its true status — no overpromising.
cap_1_name: Capture / Journal / Edit / Clip / Knowledge Processing
cap_1_desc: Zero-friction streaming capture and multi-source file parsing
cap_2_name: Kernel Write Gate · Memory Loop · Dynamic Main Surface
cap_2_desc: Write only after confirmation; changes are undoable and recoverable
cap_3_desc: Automatic filtering and cleaning of thought tags
cap_4_name: Honest Keyword Search Truncation · No Embedding Full-Library Semantic Search
cap_4_desc: Stays lightweight and transparent, prevents full-library sprawl
cap_5_name: AI Ops: Todo Maintenance · Memory Organization · Topic Suggestions
cap_6_desc: Background Prep serial, yields during Agent streaming
